# What CI's tests import beyond requirements.lock, hash-pinned so the
# install is `pip install --require-hashes -r` (OpenSSF Scorecard's
# Pinned-Dependencies). Python 3.12 on the Linux x86_64 runner only (the
# scipy hash is that one wheel); numpy comes from requirements.lock.
#   scipy (BSD-3-Clause): the satellite's resampler.
#   feedparser (BSD-2-Clause) + sgmllib3k (BSD, sdist only): the podcast
#   and news feed readers (the real-clients extra).
# Every version is at least 14 days old. To bump: take the new version's
# sha256 from its PyPI page, and keep scipy's numpy range (>=2.0,<2.8)
# satisfied by requirements.lock.
scipy==1.18.1 \
    --hash=sha256:f55fa87b6c612ecd6b058f167c53231b1d14e412efe361d3d6e38b3631c73218
feedparser==6.0.12 \
    --hash=sha256:6bbff10f5a52662c00a2e3f86a38928c37c48f77b3c511aedcd51de933549324 \
    --hash=sha256:64f76ce90ae3e8ef5d1ede0f8d3b50ce26bcce71dd8ae5e82b1cd2d4a5f94228
sgmllib3k==1.0.0 \
    --hash=sha256:7868fb1c8bfa764c1ac563d3cf369c381d1325d36124933a726f29fcdaa812e9
